## Proposal: a simpler workshop signup pilot

Volunteers currently need repeated back-and-forth to complete workshop signup. We propose a **two-week pilot with 20 volunteers** to test a simpler flow intended to reduce that effort.

We would observe whether volunteers complete signup without assistance. The success target is **at least 16 of the 20 volunteers** finishing without help. Meeting that target would not, by itself, establish readiness for a full public rollout.

The estimated cost is **$8,000, excluding tax**. The supplier quote is pending, and the venue is not confirmed. No start date, decision deadline, or person responsible for delivery has been agreed.

Please approve the **pilot approach only**. This is not a request to authorize spending before the supplier quote arrives.

## What changed

The monthly fee drops from **$120 to $100**, still **excluding tax** and with the same **twelve-month minimum term**.

The amendment also explicitly says there is **no separate annual-payment discount**. Version 1 was silent on this; that is an added clarification, not evidence that an existing discount was removed.

Sources: [Workshop service terms: version 1 — Fees](projects/humane/examples/changes/previous.md#L5-L7); [Workshop service terms: fee amendment — Fees](projects/humane/examples/changes/current.md#L9-L11).

## What you should not miss

**The lower price does not shorten the commitment or remove the cancellation obligations:**

- Customers must give **30 days’ notice before the end of the minimum term**.
- Leaving before that term ends requires paying **the remaining monthly fees**.

The amendment replaces **only the Fees section** and explicitly leaves all other terms unchanged. Cancellation still applies even though it is not repeated.

Sources: [Workshop service terms: version 1 — Cancellation](projects/humane/examples/changes/previous.md#L9-L11); [Workshop service terms: fee amendment — Scope of amendment](projects/humane/examples/changes/current.md#L5-L7).
